However there is risk of multiple VAT identifiers: ATU47239901 appears near "VAT NB." but context unclear. To comply with "Do NOT add fields", choose the clearly labeled "Part. IVA" for Sender.VatId and do not infer. So use "IT00098090210".
- Invoice.Date format: preserve as string "31/10/2022" as in document.

- All amounts have two decimals; keep them.
